title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY, AS AMENDED BY ACT NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND FORTY-EIGHT, BY PROVIDING THAT THE AMOUNTS DUE TO THE ESTATES OF DECEASED EMPLOYEES FOR ACCRUED LEAVE OF ABSENCE NOT ENJOYED SHALL BE PAID TO THE INSULAR TREASURER, AND ADMINISTERED BY HIM UNDER ACT NUMBERED TWO HUNDRED AND NINETY, ONLY IN CASE OF CITIZENS OF THE UNITED STATES.

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 80 (đã được sửa đổi bởi Đạo luật số 448) nhằm quy định các khoản tiền phải trả cho di sản của nhân viên đã mất do phép nghỉ chưa sử dụng chỉ được chi trả cho Kho bạc Đảo và quản lý theo Đạo luật số 290 trong trường hợp nhân viên là công dân Hoa Kỳ
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่แปดสิบซึ่งแก้ไขแล้วโดยพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่สี่ร้อยสี่สิบแปดโดยกำหนดให้จำนวนเงินที่ค้างจ่ายแก่มรดกของพนักงานผู้ถึงแก่กรรมสำหรับวันลาสะสมที่ไม่ได้ใช้ไปนั้นจะจ่ายให้แก่ผู้รักษาการคลังหมู่เกาะและบริหารจัดการตามพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่สองร้อยเก้าสิบได้เฉพาะกรณีที่พนักงานเป็นพลเมืองสหรัฐอเมริกาเท่านั้น
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 80 sebagaimana telah diubah oleh Undang-Undang Nomor 448 dengan menetapkan bahwa jumlah yang terutang kepada harta warisan pegawai yang meninggal dunia atas cuti akumulasi yang belum dinikmati hanya dibayarkan kepada Bendaharawan Insular dan dikelola olehnya berdasarkan Undang-Undang Nomor 290 apabila pegawai tersebut adalah warga negara Amerika Serikat
title.ms: Akta mengubah Akta Nombor Lapan Puluh sebagaimana telah diubah oleh Akta Nombor Empat Ratus Empat Puluh Lapan dengan menetapkan bahawa jumlah yang terhutang kepada harta pusaka pekerja yang telah meninggal dunia bagi cuti terkumpul yang tidak dinikmati hanya akan dibayar kepada Bendahari Insular dan diuruskan olehnya di bawah Akta Nombor Dua Ratus Sembilan Puluh sekiranya pekerja tersebut adalah warganegara Amerika Syarikat

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Eighty, entitled "An Act regulating the hours of labor, leaves of
absence, and transportation of appointees under the Philippine civil service," as amended by section one of
Act Numbered .Four hundred and forty-eight, is hereby further amended by adding at the close of the
additional paragraph added to said section two by Act Numbered Four hundred and forty-eight the following:
"And provided further, That in case the deceased head of a Bureau, provincial officer, or employee of any
Bureau was a native or citizen of the Philippine Islands, the amount due him for salary for the period of
accrued leave shall be paid, not to the Treasurer of the Philippine Islands, but to the legal representative of
the deceased according to law."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 8, 1903.
